title: This is a pure typo-fix diff — every change is a comment/docs spelling correction ("dont" → "don't", "Derivate" → "Derivative"). No functional changes.
body:
Stack from [ghstack](https://github.com/ezyang/ghstack/tree/0.15.0) (oldest at bottom):
* __->__ #187063

Fix typos in comments and docs

Correct "dont" to "don't" across various comments and fix
"Derivate" to "Derivative" in the JIT OVERVIEW docs. No
functional changes.
